mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_profiles(user_id) VALUES(#{user}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=#{user}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reading_profiles WHERE user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_metadata(id,title,author,cover,description,lexile,difficulty_level,genre,source_url) VALUES(#{id},#{title},#{author},#{cover},#{description},#{lexile},#{difficultyLevel},#{genre},#{sourceUrl}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM book_metadata ORDER BY lexile,title,id
SELECT * FROM calibration_sessions WHERE user_id=#{user} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE calibration_sessions SET status=#{status},current_step=#{currentStep},estimated_lexile=#{estimatedLexile},final_profile_json=#{finalProfileJson},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM calibration_samples WHERE session_id=#{session} ORDER BY step
mapper.update: UPDATE calibration_samples SET finished_at=#{finishedAt},reading_seconds=#{readingSeconds},lookup_count=#{lookupCount},comprehension_score=#{comprehensionScore},flow_score=#{flowScore} WHERE session_id=#{sessionId} AND step=#{step} AND finished_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reading_progress WHERE user_id=#{user} ORDER BY updated_at DESC,book_id,chapter_id LIMIT 5

SELECT book_id,SUM(completed_paragraphs) AS completed_paragraphs,SUM(total_paragraphs) AS total_paragraphs,SUM(total_reading_ms) AS total_reading_ms,MAX(updated_at) AS updated_at FROM reading_progress WHERE user_id=#{user} GROUP BY book_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC,book_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS attempts,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN semantic_verdict='correct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS correct FROM review_attempts WHERE user_id=#{user} AND grading_state='completed' AND stage='initial'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN review_status='mastered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS mastered,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN review_status IN ('new','learning') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS learning,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN review_status='reviewing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS reviewing,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN review_status!='mastered' AND next_review_at <=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS due FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user}
SELECT * FROM lookup_items WHERE user_id=#{user} AND paragraph_index IS NOT NULL AND book_id=#{book} AND chapter_id=#{chapter} ORDER BY paragraph_index,id
